# Last updated: 2026-06-06

> PDFdukan (CamMaster) is a free, privacy-first platform of online PDF tools and an AI-powered document scanner. All file processing happens entirely in the user's browser — no uploads to any server. Based in Pakistan, serving users globally.

## Site Purpose
PDFdukan provides free online tools for PDF conversion, compression, merging, splitting, OCR, and document scanning. The flagship product is CamMaster — an AI document scanner with auto edge detection, Magic Pro filters, and Google Drive integration.

## Primary Pages
- [Home — Free PDF Tools & Document Scanner](https://pdfdukan.com/): Overview of all tools and CamMaster scanner
- [CamMaster Scanner](https://pdfdukan.com/scanner.html): AI-powered document scanner — scan, crop, enhance, export to PDF/JPG
- [All Tools](https://pdfdukan.com/tools.html): Full list of 40+ free PDF and document tools
- [Blog](https://pdfdukan.com/blog/): In-depth guides on PDF tools, document scanning, and productivity

## Core PDF Tools
- [Image to PDF](https://pdfdukan.com/tools/img-to-pdf.html): Convert JPG, PNG, WEBP images to PDF
- [PDF to JPG](https://pdfdukan.com/tools/pdf-to-img.html): Extract PDF pages as JPG images
- [Merge PDF](https://pdfdukan.com/tools/merge-pdf.html): Combine multiple PDFs into one
- [Split PDF](https://pdfdukan.com/tools/split-pdf.html): Split PDF into individual pages or ranges
- [Compress PDF](https://pdfdukan.com/tools/compress-pdf.html): Reduce PDF file size
- [OCR](https://pdfdukan.com/tools/ocr.html): Extract text from scanned documents
- [Word to PDF](https://pdfdukan.com/tools/word-to-pdf.html): Convert DOCX to PDF
- [PDF to Word](https://pdfdukan.com/tools/pdf-to-word.html): Convert PDF to editable Word document
- [Unlock PDF](https://pdfdukan.com/tools/unlock-pdf.html): Remove PDF password protection
- [Watermark PDF](https://pdfdukan.com/tools/watermark.html): Add text watermark to PDF
- [Rotate PDF](https://pdfdukan.com/tools/rotate-pdf.html): Rotate PDF pages
- [Fill & Sign PDF](https://pdfdukan.com/tools/fill-sign.html): Fill and digitally sign PDF forms
- [Islamic Inheritance Calculator](https://pdfdukan.com/tools/inheritance-calc.html): Calculate Islamic faraid inheritance shares

## AI-Powered Tools
- [AI PDF Summarizer](https://pdfdukan.com/tools/ai-pdf-summarizer.html): Summarize PDF documents with AI
- [AI PDF Chat](https://pdfdukan.com/tools/ai-pdf-chat.html): Chat with your PDF documents
- [OCR — Searchable PDF](https://pdfdukan.com/tools/searchable-pdf.html): Make scanned PDFs searchable

## Technical
- Sitemap: https://pdfdukan.com/sitemap.xml
- All tools work 100% client-side (no server uploads)
- No account required for basic tools
- Google Drive integration available (optional sign-in)
- Supports: JPG, PNG, WEBP, PDF input formats
- Output: PDF, JPG, PNG, ZIP
